description: This file defines the AgentRegistry class, which manages agent sessions including creation, updating, retrieval, and deletion of sessions, as well as handling session logs and states.

classes.name: AgentRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages agent sessions, including creation, updates, and state management.

methods.name: setPendingSession
methods.description: Sets a pending session while waiting for CLI's session_created event.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new agent session with specified parameters.

methods.name: hasActiveProcess
methods.description: Checks if a session has an active process based on its status and pid.

methods.name: updateSessionStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and related properties of a session.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its ID.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Returns all sessions sorted by start time.

methods.name: getSessionsForGitUrl
methods.description: Filters sessions by associated git URL.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a log line to a session's logs, maintaining a maximum log size.

methods.name: setSessionPid
methods.description: Sets the process ID for a session.

methods.name: updateSessionMode
methods.description: Updates the mode of a session.

methods.name: updateParallelModeInfo
methods.description: Updates parallel mode information for a session.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the agent registry.

methods.name: getStateForGitUrl
methods.description: Returns the state filtered by a specific git URL.

methods.name: hasPendingOrRunningSessions
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending or running sessions.

methods.name: hasRunningSessions
methods.description: Checks if there are any running sessions.

methods.name: getRunningSessionCount
methods.description: Counts the number of sessions with status 'running'.

methods.name: removeSession
methods.description: Removes a session by its ID.

methods.name: renameSession
methods.description: Renames a session ID, merging logs if necessary.
